llm_response.reason: The website mimics a well-known French fashion retailer ('Jules') both in branding and product listings, a hallmark of brand spoofing (Characteristic 16). There is no verifiable company contact information, address, or professional business email—only a generic web form (Characteristics 4, 6). The privacy policy is ambiguously titled in Spanish ('Privacidad'), not French, indicating template use and operator location confusion (Characteristic 7). SSL certificate security issues were detected, increasing risk. All these match multiple scam characteristics, confirming it is a fake online shopping scam.
